**Final Velocity**

\[
v_{\text{f}} = u + a\,t = 20 \,\frac{\mathrm{m}}{\mathrm{s}} + 5 \,\frac{\mathrm{m}}{\mathrm{s^{2}}}\times 6 \,\mathrm{s}
              = 20 + 30 
              = 50 \;\frac{\mathrm{m}}{\mathrm{s}}
\]

---

**Total Distance Traveled**

\[
d = u\,t + \frac12 a\,t^{2}= 20\times 6 + \frac12(5)(6)^2
   = 120 + \frac12(5)(36)
   = 120 + 90
   = 210 \;\mathrm{m}
\]

> **Answer:**  
> • Final velocity: **\(50~\text{m/s}\)**  
> • Total distance travelled: **\(210~\text{meters}\)**
